description: Keyword search over the published catalog, with the site's full-text filters (Turkish task phrases, country words such as "turkey", facets such as "free" or "open source"); every word is read as finished, never as a prefix: up to 12 tools in rank order, each once, with id, name, kind, tagline, pricing and tool page URL, and the catalog tasks a Turkish phrase in the query named (often none for English queries; use list_tasks for those). One job per call: search 'send email' and 'accept payments' separately. Results are not judged for fit, so check them with get_tool.

query.description: A few words naming the job, e.g. "send transactional email" or "accept payments in turkey".
